caption: The drawing features a single, oval-shaped object resembling an old oil lamp or lantern, centrally positioned on a plain, light beige background. The object is rendered in shades of brown and dark gray, indicating a metallic appearance, with subtle highlights and shadows to suggest depth and form. It has a hinged lid at the top center with a small, rounded knob, and two curved, spout-like protrusions at one end. Attached to the back of the lamp, there is a thin, bent handle with a rounded loop at the upper end, rising vertically and curving outward, colored similarly to the body of the lamp. The artist’s signature, “David S. DeVault,” is visible in the bottom right corner of the paper, written in a small, neat script. The entire composition is minimalist, with the object isolated and no additional elements or background details.
title: Betty Lamp
